title: The coast west of the station, and the island under the monorail
caption: The ride used to stay over open sea right up to the platforms. Now, as the train pulls in, the line comes down off the bay, the sea wall and its rocks pass under the car, then lawn with pines, a walk out to a terrace over the rocks, and the platforms. On the island map, the ground west of the platform shed is built: a coast path with a lookout, black pines, the sea wall. Backdrop only (issue #144).

sections.title: Pulling in (desktop)
sections.caption: Before: the start of the arrival, and three seconds in. After: 4, 5, 6 and 7 seconds after the arrival starts (it now runs in at speed for about four seconds before braking).

images.caption: After, 4 s: the rocks come in
After, 5 s: over the sea wall
After, 6 s: the south walk and its terrace

sections.title: Pulling in (phone)
sections.caption: The phone looks along the car, so the coast comes down the sides.

sections.title: The island map
sections.caption: The forecourt's tile now reaches the coast and covers the platform shed, so there is no sea in the middle of the island. The court's own cameras never see this far, so play frames there are unchanged.
